summary.text: Sue Rezin is a Republican member of the Illinois State Senate who has represented District 38 since 2010 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She is the co-owner and manager of a real estate company.

paragraphs.text: Rezin earned a bachelor's degree from Augustana College and lists her profession as co-owner and manager of a real estate company.
Her campaign website says she grew up on a small family farm near Geneseo, Illinois, and that agriculture is the leading industry in the district she represents.
Rezin succeeded Gary Dahl in the Illinois State Senate in 2010.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 17, 2026.
